directus/directus.note: Workspace packages such as @directus/env resolve to dist/, so the test package's dependencies are built first. Native modules (sqlite3, isolated-vm) need install scripts, which the eval enables.

laurent22/joplin.note: Jest only runs tsc-compiled .test.js files, so every test Trace writes would need compiling before it can run.

n8n-io/n8n.note: Workspace packages (e.g. @n8n/vitest-config, n8n-workflow) resolve to dist/, so the test's package dependencies are built first.

outline/outline.note: Server tests need a Postgres database. Shared-code tests work (outline#13722 passes), but most cases are server-side.

RocketChat/Rocket.Chat.note: Needs a ~15 minute workspace build, mixes jest and mocha by file, and a bundled Yarn plugin refuses any Node but the pinned one.

twentyhq/twenty.prepare: cp -n packages/twenty-front/.env.example packages/twenty-front/.env 2>/dev/null; npx nx run-many -t build -p twenty-shared twenty-ui twenty-emails
twentyhq/twenty.note: twenty-shared, twenty-ui and twenty-emails resolve to dist/. Jest must run from the package with its jest.config.mjs, which the runner detection now does.
